description: 인천국제공항공사_셔틀버스정보 [bus and public transit and airports] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 인천국제공항공사. 인천국제공항 무료셔틀버스 각 노선마다 정류장별 도착예측 데이터로 정류장 ID 순번,노선ID, 제공시간,위치,도착예측시간 등으로 인천국제공항 무료 셔틀 버스 AICC, T1,T2 노선의. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 인천국제공항공사. Its tags are 셔틀버스, 정류장, 노선버스, 출발시간, 도착예측. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2026-08-06 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
